provenance.re_pin_note: Re-pinned 2026-11-24 from the native macOS release binary for issue #75. The previous floors (binary eca0565e..., commit 8a2cd36) are unreproducible: rebuilding that exact commit with the CLT toolchain and the ort-crate static ONNX Runtime yields different, deterministic metrics. ONNX Runtime build/linkage drifts embeddings across builds at the same magnitude as the previously documented cross-platform drift (rust-inventory-audit-v1 floor exception, PR #67 java exception). Native-vs-container parity probe: 2 of 8 fixture queries reorder, including one #1 flip.
